items.a: Students, student founders, innovators and early-stage startups from any city in India — along with colleges, mentors, investors and industry partners who want to support them. You don't need a startup to begin; an idea, or even curiosity, is enough.

items.q: Does it cost anything to apply?
items.a: Applying to join the movement is free. Any program with a participation fee will state it clearly before you commit.

items.q: I don't have a startup yet. Can I still join?
items.a: Yes. LaunchBharat is designed for people at the very beginning — the journey starts with discovering and developing ideas, not with pitch decks.

items.q: How does my idea reach the Grand Finale?
items.a: Through the movement's journey: discover, develop, connect, validate, scale, launch. Participants advance through campus and regional programs; the strongest ideas are invited to the national stage.
Institutions can apply to host roadshows, bootcamps and regional programs on campus. Write to us through the contact page and the partnerships team will follow up.

items.q: How are mentors and partners selected?
items.a: Mentors and partners are onboarded through verified, formal relationships. The website only displays associations that have been approved — nothing on this platform is fabricated credibility.
